query: What methods can be used to report illegal mining activities in forested regions of Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
Reporting Illegal Mining:
To report illegal mining in forest areas of Tamil Nadu, contact the Tamil Nadu Forest Department's toll-free number (1800-425-3355) or visit the nearest forest range office. You can also report anonymously through the department's website or mobile app.
answer: To report illegal mining in forested areas of Tamil Nadu, one can contact the Forest Department directly, lodge a complaint with local police stations, or use online platforms like the Tamil Nadu Police's website. [Document 1]
